summary: LANDSCAPE refactor (844x390) validated end-to-end against the live preview URL. ALL 10 requested flows PASS: (1) Auth 2-column login works with tester1@belote.tn/Belote123!. (2) Home 2x2 grid: all four cards (play-online, play-solo, learn, private-game) render within y+h<=266px, well under the 390px viewport, no content clipped by the ad banner or tab bar. (3) Private modal exposes join-code-input, join-room-button, create-party-button; create->match-type-short lands on /room/{code}. (4) Room screen is a clean 2-col: room-code-text + share + Inviter/Lancer buttons on the left, 4-seat grid on the right; start-game-button transitions to /game/{id}. (5) Solo full loop: play-solo-card->Partie courte->/game/*, bidding-panel renders (suit chips, value pills 90-160, Passer/Capot/Annoncer/Contrer), pass-button works, hand-card-* click plays a card from the hand fan (bounds y=285 h=97 -> bottom=382, within 390). chat-button opens the quick chat panel; no vertical overflow (documentHeight==windowHeight==390). (6) RotateGate: [data-testid=rotate-gate] appears at 390x844 with 'Tourne ton téléphone…', disappears immediately at 844x390. (7) Matchmaking screen fits: cancel-search-button at y=336 h=42 bottom=378<=390, cancel returns to /home. (8) Tutorial: 14 lessons, Leçon 1 'Bienvenue!' content centered and readable. (9) Tabs Accueil/Classement/Amis/Profil all render correctly centered in landscape. (10) Rejoin: resume-game-banner + resume-game-button return to same /game/{id}. Only pre-existing cosmetic console error remains (transform-origin -> transformOrigin), unchanged from iteration_18.

react_native_issues.issue: Console error still present in landscape build: 'Invalid DOM property `transform-origin`. Did you mean `transformOrigin`?' — same warning already flagged in iteration_18. Likely a kebab-case CSS key spread from a Reanimated web shim used on tutorial route / matchmaking ShufflingCard. Non-blocking, cosmetic. Reference: /app/frontend/app/matchmaking.tsx (ShufflingCard) and /app/frontend/app/tutorial/*

action_items: Optional cosmetic: fix `transform-origin` -> `transformOrigin` in the Reanimated animation styles (matchmaking.tsx ShufflingCard and/or tutorial screen intro). Same item as iteration_18, still unresolved but non-blocking.

Optional testability: room screen shows 'Inviter des amis' and 'Lancer la partie' but only start-game-button has a testID; consider adding testID="invite-friend-button" for future automation (start-game-button works fine).

Optional: game-quit modal has 'Rester'/'Quitter' — the 'quit-continue-later' testID mentioned in prior context does not exist in the current UI (nothing wrong functionally: 'Rester' cancels, 'Quitter' ends). If the intended behavior is 'quit but keep resumable' you may want a separate action.
critical_code_review_comments: Landscape layout looks solid across every screen: home.tsx grid gridItem flexBasis 48% + gap yields exactly 2x2 with card min-height 88 -> 2*88 + gap ~194 px, comfortably under 390 minus header (~80) and ad banner (~40). Numbers observed in DOM confirm (bottom row cards end at y=266).

RotateGate.tsx is correct: `portrait = Platform.OS==='web' && height > width` toggles the absolute-fill overlay via useWindowDimensions. Verified live: overlay z-index 9999 covers the app in portrait and removes cleanly on rotate.

BiddingPanel is compact and centered (~660px wide within 844 viewport, ~250px tall centered vertically over the felt). No overlap with hand fan (fan starts y~285, panel bottom at y~275 during bidding).
HandFan lives inside a bottom row that stays inside the 390px viewport (bottom edge at 382). Cards remain fully clickable (verified by playing a card successfully).
Matchmaking cancel button at y=336 h=42 fits — but the margin (12px above viewport bottom) is tight; if font scales up on other devices this could clip. Non-blocking.
